# Cloud Harness MCP

> A private, single-owner remote coding harness. AI coding agents connect over authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP and get isolated, non-root Docker sandboxes to clone, build, test, commit, and push, while credentials stay in the trusted control plane and out of the executor.

Cloud Harness MCP is open source (MIT) and self-hosted. It is not a hostile multi-tenant sandbox: it trusts one owner and constrains what repository-controlled code can reach.

## Product

- [Home](https://harness.agentkit.best/): Architecture (stateless ingress, policy runner, non-root sandbox), the bounded coding workflow, the MCP tool set, client setup, and installation.
- [HaaS design](https://harness.agentkit.best/haas.html): Design notes for a hosted, multi-tenant "Harness as a Service" built on microVM isolation. Design stage, not a shipped product.
- [Support](https://harness.agentkit.best/support.html): Where to get help and report issues.

## Documentation

- [Docs home](https://docs.harness.agentkit.best/): Full user and operator documentation.

- [Getting started](https://docs.harness.agentkit.best/getting-started.md): Open a workspace and run the first commands.
- [Security model](https://docs.harness.agentkit.best/security-model.md): Threat model, network isolation, and credential boundaries.
